howto.what: 让 Claude 掌握示例工程博客这份 RSS 源的内容:共 4 篇文章、2 位作者(Jane Doe、John Roe)及按标签分类的目录,可据此查文章、主题和作者观点。

howto.what_en: Gives Claude the contents of the Example Engineering Blog RSS feed: 4 articles, 2 authors (Jane Doe, John Roe) and tags, so it can look up posts, topics and author views.
howto.when_en: Marked in the source as for testing the rss golden build; the body says to use it when referencing Example Engineering Blog articles, looking up topics, or finding author views.
